proposal.summary: An excessively large PDF page size can cause a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code, discovered via fuzzing and unlikely in normal PDFs.
proposal.cwe_quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the vendor or reporter to provide affected Xpdf version range, a proof-of-concept file, and whether the crash can be triggered by opening/parsing an untrusted PDF in typical usage; if confirmed, reproduce the issue and develop a fix to validate/divide-by-zero-check the page-size handling.

evidence_quotes.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
